name: echo_ptr12_1
prompt: This is an upscaled crop of a photoreal audio-plugin UI. Output ONE image, landscape 1536x1024, with EXACTLY the same framing, scale, perspective, lighting, colours and every detail as the input, so it overlays the input pixel for pixel. Change ONLY this: rotate ONLY the ECHO knob (the black scalloped knob in the centre) so its cream pointer line points straight up at 12 o'clock. The knob turns as a solid object: its lobes turn with it, but the lighting stays where it is (soft highlight on top, the smooth dark wide base at the bottom, the same soft shadow on the panel). Same size, same position, same shape. The printed ticks, labels, panel and every other knob stay exactly the same. Everything outside that change must stay identical to the input.
